caitya (a sacred shrine or tree) is kept as a name. vidula is obscure and left untranslated. kumbheṣu is locative; nālīn and vidulāni are the accusative objects of dhamantaḥ ('blowing tubes or vidulas in pots'). In Hindi तीक्ष्ण stands alone (glossary), set off by commas. 'pūjā no vartatām' is literally 'let worship be/go on for us'. svāmin = king per glossary.

summary: Reviewed 50 units (13.2.1-50). Issues: 3 error, 43 minor; units with a patch: 27. Errors: 21 (objects of dhamantaḥ turned into places), 34 (unmarked 'rite'/'कर्म' added; the dvandva needs no noun), 47 (invented predicate 'hindered' and garbled Hindi). Flags: 3 samāgatāś confirmed (singular kathayet), 3 (vṛṣīṣva?) confirmed as not applied (w corrected to vṛṇīṣva); 8 pṛṣṭhaḥ confirmed; 11 abhīnītaṃ confirmed (unit 16 prints abhinītaṃ); 33 naimititka confirmed; 46 dhig.ukty rejected (plain sandhi, flag emptied). naimittika settled as 'omen-reader' (नैमित्तिक), added to the glossary. Systematic fixes: X-vyañjana compounds are bahuvrīhi, not tat-puruṣa; kath is 10th class, not causative; speculative senses removed from notes of 4, 46, 48. No regrouping suggested for any unit; 45-50 stay as the edition groups them. Needs a person: 50 sattra-hetubhiḥ vs glossary 'hiding-place' (43); the sense of 47b (guards' movement) and 44 compound; 11/16 krama-abhinīta; 12/14/17 back-references; 19 pratipannam/bimba; 29 ūrdhva-bhakṣita; 48/49 phelā. All layers remain unreviewed AI drafts.
